name_reason: Already conforms to data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: domain=dialog, descriptor=shop_auto_equip_dialog_text_id_table. Reflects data type (a per-tier table of int16 FDTXT text ids). No Ghidra address residue (no hex suffix equal to its own/any data address). The '6' dimension and the shop/auto_equip semantics are domain-meaningful, not address artifacts.
purpose: Per-shop-tier FDTXT dialog page text-id for the 'auto-equip the gear just bought?' yes/no prompt in the chapter-intro shop buy flow.
logic_summary: Sole reader fd2_run_buy_item_menu @ 0x2F0ED block-copies the 12 bytes into a stack-local buffer (3x MOVSD), then -- only on the gear branch after fd2_add_item_to_inventory -- reads it back as a signed 16-bit word indexed by data_fd2_chapter_intro_menu_cursor_state*2 (MOVSX) and passes the value as the FDTXT page id to fd2_display_dialog_scene, followed by fd2_text_dialog_typewriter_loop for the yes/no reply. The *2 stride + MOVSX word access confirms int16 (signed) elements; the 0..5 cursor_state range gives the 6-element dimension.
element_semantics: element[tier] (tier = shop-tier radio state data_fd2_chapter_intro_menu_cursor_state, 0..5) = FDTXT dialog page id for the auto-equip yes/no prompt at that shop tier. Values {0x0001,0x01FB,0x0001,0x01FB,0x0001,0x01FB}: even tiers (0,2,4) use placeholder/blank page 0x0001; odd tiers (1,3,5) use the live auto-equip prompt page 0x01FB.
notes: Verified: read_memory @ 0x5271E = 0100fb01 0100fb01 0100fb01 = {0x0001,0x01FB,0x0001,0x01FB,0x0001,0x01FB}, matching the src initializer exactly. xrefs_to: only fd2_run_buy_item_menu (READ @ 0x2F0F2, DATA @ 0x2F0ED) -> single reader, no writers -> const confirmed. Ghidra datatype=short[6] len=12. Ghidra plate was <null>; created a concise plate consistent with the src comment (src is authority). src comment block (dlgtab.c lines 111-131) was already accurate and well-formed ASCII -> comment_verdict=keep, no src edit. The decompiler renders the stack-local read as auto_equip_dialog_table+cursor_state*2-4; this is the same block-copied stack buffer the src/Ghidra plate describe (frame-relative vs variable-relative rendering of the MOVSX word read). No logic changes made.
